name: Chief Minister’s Award for Excellence in Public Administration
benefit:
##### ***Chief Minister's Award for Excellence in Public Administration***

- The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash Award of ₹10,00,000/- each.
- Two such awards are given: one each for Departments’ and Organizations/Institutions’ categories.

##### ***Chief Minister's Appreciation for Initiative in Public Administration***

- The award carries a Commendation Scroll and a Cash
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must represent one of the following: a) A Local Body under the UT of Puducherry. b) An Autonomous Body under the UT of Puducherry. c) A Corporation under the UT of Puducherry. d) An Agency under the UT of Puducherry. e) A Public Sector Undertaking under the UT of Puducherry. f) A Government Department under the UT of Puducherry. - The applicant must be nominated only through the Administrative Secretary. - The applicant must submit an application that contains the recommendation of the Departmental Committee. - The applicant must propose achievements of initiatives and projects whose qualitative and quantitative outcomes/results are of very high order and which have benefitted a large number of citizens. - The application should be made for rewardable work done during the previous one calendar year as on the date of nomination.
